title: Sound of the Zither
summary: Demon Emperor Gu Yunchi scolds the Emperor Sword Spirit, a spoiled girl, for nearly wrecking Sky Demon City over Wang Lin, then takes her out into the city. Alone, Wang Lin listens to a sad zither tune and thinks of Li Muwan, deciding that defying heaven means keeping feeling in one's heart. Mo Lihai takes him to Vice Commander-in-Chief Xuan, who has just received Mo Fei; Xuan tests Wang Lin and says that with him Mo Lihai's chance rises from forty to ninety percent. That night two of Mo Fei's men try to assassinate Wang Lin with the Ink Dot Spear and the Chaos Heaven Seal, and his killing intent destroys them. Mo Fei gets the Emperor's leave for a private duel with Mo Lihai, and his messenger Wei Yang of the Da Lou Sword Sect attacks Wang Lin as All-Seer's disciple; Wang Lin breaks his sword qi and his goat soul, survives the life-staked sword qi of Ling Tianhou, and takes that sword qi from him. Mo Lihai loses the duel to Mo Fei, which bars him from fighting in the tournament, so everything now rests on Wang Lin.

changes: Sources: AnimeKhor Indonesian fansub and the official YouTube English track (both clear).
Gu Yunchi follows the glossary title; the official subtitles say Gu Yundun (古云沌).
Official English: Mo Lihai says Mo Fei 'often strikes from the shadows'; the fansub says the opposite. The official line is used.
The YouTube Chinese track is a machine back-translation of the English (e.g. 叛逆仙人, 顾云盾), so it was not used for 汉字.
flags: Who plays the zither and who remarks 'so he is also a heartbroken soul' (226s fansub) is not shown clearly.
Wei Yang addresses Wang Lin as the 'Zixi seventh disciple' (official 1050s); Wang Lin's place in All-Seer's line is not explained here.
Li Muwan appears only in Wang Lin's memory.
